SplitMix64 reference: https://prng.di.unimi.it/splitmix.c
Applied to tools/ai-tuner/src/rng.rs and tools/ai-tuner/komi-study.mjs.
Changes: Rust / JavaScript BigInt translation, per-instance state, seed mixing,
and sampling helpers. The following is the upstream dedication and permission.
